data.name: 1 Hr - Real Hollywood Sign Tour
data.headline: Best photo spot! • 1hr • Up to 7 people!
data.description:
#We'll get you up-close with our secret location!

##Rates
**Person** - $29

*This tour is for up to 7 people*

##Duration
1hr

##About
There is no need to hike the entire day for just one picture!
By using small mini-vans, we will get you to the very TOP of Hollywood Hills for the best photos with The HOLLYWOOD Sign. Our secret location is a hidden hiking trail in a residential neighborhood, where you would be able to get your shots without noisy tourists in the back.
This spot is only used by GOLDENTICKETLA Tours; please beware of other tour companies who OVERPROMISE and UNDERDELIVER !!!
